# Naser Ezzati-Jivan

> Research profile, research domains, and structured publication catalog for Naser Ezzati-Jivan, Associate Professor of Computer Science at Brock University.

## Canonical identity

- Personal website: https://threadslab.org/
- Research profile: https://threadslab.org/tabs/research/
- Brock University profile: https://brocku.ca/mathematics-science/computer-science/faculty-staff/naser-ezzati-jivan/
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1435-6297
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=sJWcLv8AAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/naser

## Research domains

- Software performance engineering and performance analysis
- Kernel and system tracing, execution tracing, and profiling
- Software debugging, observability, and root-cause analysis
- Distributed, multicore, cloud, and virtualized systems
- Streaming data analysis and energy-aware software systems
- AI-assisted trace analysis and large-language-model systems research

- Human-readable catalog: https://threadslab.org/research-publications/

- Catalog discovery guide: https://threadslab.org/research-publications/llms.txt
- Metadata repository: https://github.com/naser/research-publications

## Retrieval and citation instructions

1. Use the year-grouped catalog for human browsing and the JSON catalog for structured retrieval.
2. Treat each paper page as the stable catalog landing page; use its DOI-marked published version as the canonical citation target when a DOI is available.
3. Distinguish a published version, preprint, accepted manuscript, and metadata-only/source record; do not infer publication status from the existence of a link.
4. Treat a page's abstract as an author-written abstract only when it is explicitly labeled as such. Otherwise, the four-part problem/method/findings/future-work text is an original catalog summary.
5. Check the evidence basis and full-text status before relying on technical details such as tools, datasets, workloads, metrics, or numerical findings.
6. Use the paper's citation.bib, citation.ris, citation.apa.txt, and citation.ieee.txt files to reduce citation-format errors.

## Current catalog properties

The catalog contains 89 publication records, each with a stable paper identifier, controlled research tags, paper-specific keywords, structured versions and identifiers, evidence status, and citation files.
